prosody_instruction: Speak softly, as if thinking aloud to oneself rather than addressing anyone. Slow pace, drifting cadence, occasional trailing-off at clause ends. Avoid directive intonation. The tone should feel introspective, distracted, almost wandering — like someone remembering, imagining, or recounting to themselves rather than asking a listener for help.

chunks.text: Back in 2025 I was in Suzhou for a couple days, and we kept joking that the food alone was the whole trip.
Then later that year I also spent a weekend in Wuhan, and everyone around me was talking about shows happening there.
One night in Suzhou we ended up at Dexing Noodle House—our group was huge, like 10 people, so it felt like a mini reunion.
I remember the dinner was on 2025-03-26, and whoever arranged it put it down for 20:00, which was perfect after we finished wandering around.
The reservation details were under Luo Fei, and the contact number they used was 13813897597—someone had it saved and just forwarded it to the group chat.
In Wuhan my friend Wang Fang had already gotten two tickets for the JJ Lin Concert—Floor seats—and she used her phone 13822334455 when she bought them.
